newsitem.title: USA: PG&E names new CEO to Energy Services.
newsitem.headline: PG&E names new CEO to Energy Services.

text.p: PG&E Corp announced Monday it has appointed Scott Gebhardt president and chief executive officer of PG&E Energy Services, the new name for its retail energy services subsidiary.
The company was previously known as Vantus Energy Corp.
His most recent position was as executive vice president of PennUnion Energy Services, L.L.C, the natural gas marketing subsidiary of Houston-based Pennzoil Co.
PG&E formed Vantus Energy in 1995 to develop comprehensive energy services for commercial and industrial customers nationwide.
San Francisco will remain the headquarters for PG&E Energy Services. Current satellite offices will continue to operate in Portland, Ore., Phoenix, Ariz., and Los Angeles, Calif.
